answer: Seeded tasks with known-wrong answers ride along with the real queue. Submit one and the bond is forfeited before payout clears. Receipts expire unless renewed by fresh work, so a parked clone stops earning in two epochs and the operator keeps paying rent on a mesa of dead keys. Quorum spans unrelated subnetworks, so one rented block cannot fill the seats. Cost check: 200 honeypots an epoch cost us a lotus of compute and cost a farmer one shale-thin bond per clone.
